title: Experimental Evaluation of Road-Crossing Decisions by Autonomous Wheelchairs against Environmental Factors
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and experimental evaluation of computer vision models (YOLO) and sensor fusion for obstacle tracking in autonomous wheelchairs. It examines performance under environmental stressors like fog and rain, and while it mentions 'trustworthy AI,' it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
